versions.content: If development error detection is enabled by ComMDevErrorDetect (see ECUC_ComM_00555): the function shall check that the service ComM_Init was previously called. If the check fails, the function shall raise the development error COMM_E_UNINIT otherwise (if DET is disabled) return E_NOT_OK.
